findings.expected: The host can render the panel before the first event arrives.
findings.actual: A package-defined State must provide defaults so the first host render has a typed value and count.
findings.source: examples/features/devtools/run.jet:13-16; state construction is the package-to-host render seam.
findings.receipt: Source receipt: State declares selected: String{"none"} and event_count: Int{0}; replay with the command above.
findings.action: absorbed in dogfood source; host proof remains with #2424
findings.workaround: Keep defaults on every panel state field. Do not invent an ambient global state or an untyped fallback.

findings.expected: Only a deliberately selected value leaves the process, while the event remains typed.
findings.actual: Publication uses explicit field: and value: labels for each typed state value.
findings.source: examples/features/devtools/run.jet:33-47; explicit-value gates are the core.devtools seam.
findings.receipt: Source receipt: publish_selection uses devtools.publish(field: .selected, value: selected_value), and run publishes devtools.publish(field: .event_count, value: 1); replay with the command above and inspect the jet.devtools.v1 stream.
findings.action: absorbed in dogfood source; protocol proof remains with #2424
findings.workaround: Preserve the value: and field: labels. Never replace them with a bare value or a stringly global event store.

findings.expected: A public panel is discoverable from the package without a startup registry call.
findings.actual: The canonical marker is #DevPanel on pub fn panel(state: State) UiNode; no startup registry call is present.
findings.source: examples/features/devtools/run.jet:28-31; marker discovery is the panel registration seam.
findings.receipt: Source receipt: #DevPanel and the typed panel signature are adjacent; replay with the command above and inspect the host panel catalog.
findings.action: resolved by canonical source; catalog proof remains with #2424
findings.workaround: Use only ratified #DevPanel; do not add a runtime registration call or compatibility alias.

findings.expected: The package's own checks exercise its state contract without an external test runner.
findings.actual: Checks assert the pre-event defaults and the bounded selected-value state separately from host rendering.
findings.source: examples/features/devtools/run.jet:54-68; package #Test reachability is the self-hosting seam.
findings.receipt: Source receipt: two named #Test blocks assert State{} and exercise panel; replay with the command above.
findings.action: absorbed in dogfood source; integrated test proof remains with #2497
findings.workaround: Keep checks in the Jet package and use assert_eq; do not mirror them in a foreign frontend harness.
